cohort: 24 women who underwent vaginal cesarean section over a 10-year period
finding: Vaginal cesarean section is a suitable option for the extraction of medium-sized dead or nonviable fetuses when pharmacological options are ineffective or not rapid enough in cases of poor maternal condition.
mod_finding: This study examines vaginal cesarean section as a method of delivery, particularly for the extraction of medium-sized dead or nonviable fetuses.
gest_age: Median 24 weeks + 5 days (range 18 to 34 weeks + 1 day)
